newsitem.title: USA: Monet Group Inc names Robert Mang CEO.
newsitem.headline: Monet Group Inc names Robert Mang CEO.

text.p: Monet Group Inc, the marketer and maker of fashion jewelry, on Wednesday announced the appointment of Robert Mang as the company's chief executive officer.

Mang joins Monet after serving as vice chairman of Duty Free Shoppers Ltd, where he was responsible for the marketing, merchandising, allocation and distribution functions worldwide, the privately held company said in a statement.
The name of his predecessor was not immediately available.
A Monet spokeswoman said Mang succeeds Judy Harrison, who resigned as president and chief executive in May.
The president title is still open at the company, the spokeswoman said.
